exposure: Patient-reported social needs (e.g., transportation, medication unaffordability, food insecurity, housing insecurity, mental health care needs)
cohort: A large cohort of 20,480 pregnant individuals who underwent universal social determinants of health screening during pregnancy between May 2021 and July 2023.
finding: Patient-reported social needs were associated with an increased risk of severe maternal morbidity and low birth weight, with a greater association for severe maternal morbidity and preeclampsia observed among pregnant people with Medicaid insurance.
